name: 27127 · Winston Salem, NC
findings: ZIP 27127 (Winston Salem) has 133 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27127 (Winston Salem) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 15 housing organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do housing organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27127 (Winston Salem) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27127 (Winston Salem) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
